reason: Integrates DSH with the openai-codex provider through ChatGPT/Codex OAuth, including credential management, status display, and login/logout controls.

summaries.zh: 通过 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 为 DSH 提供 openai-codex 订阅认证、令牌管理、状态查看和登录控制功能。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with ChatGPT/Codex OAuth authentication for the openai-codex provider, including token management, status monitoring, and login controls.

capabilities: Persistent storage and automatic refresh of access and refresh tokens
External HTTP requests to authentication and subscription-status endpoints
Web settings panel and in-conversation authentication tools
Local HTTP status, login, and logout endpoints
